content.title: Heavy Attack vs Light Swarm | Evasion, Regrouping, Binding Reversal
content.summary: Establish two clearly adult original opponents, one heavy attack system and one light swarm system. Require the heavy attack to commit a readable path before the swarm changes formation. Make the swarm evade, preserve units and regroup behind the attack path to bind one functional point. Escalate binding through the attacker's repeated force while keeping both adult identities and geography readable. End on a stable immobilization proof with the controller unharmed and the attacker's original weapon still identifiable.

quick_start.input_format: Establish two clearly adult original opponents, one heavy attack system and one light swarm system. + Require the heavy attack to commit a readable path before the swarm changes formation. + Make the swarm evade, preserve units and regroup behind the attack path to bind one functional point. + Escalate binding through the attacker's repeated force while keeping both adult identities and geography readable. + End on a stable immobilization proof with the controller unharmed and the attacker's original weapon still identifiable.
quick_start.recommended_input: In an original snow-covered radio yard, establish a clearly adult broad-shouldered salvage worker with a red magnetic hammer facing a clearly adult drone wrangler in a white utility coat; a flock of thin black inspection drones circles her. After the hammer passes, the same drones curve behind it, reconnect as flexible black bands and wrap only the hammer head and wrist while both adults remain readable. Hold the worker immobilized upright by the same banded drones; the adult wrangler stands unharmed at the original yard marker and lowers one hand. No text, copied costumes or source weapons.
